mapper.sql: bb.battle_id, bb.guild_id, g.name AS guild_name, bb.boss_id, bb.season_id, b.name AS boss_name, b.difficulty, b.image_url AS boss_image_url, bb.status, bb.max_hp, bb.current_hp, bb.total_damage, bb.started_at, bb.ended_at, CAST(CONCAT(CAST(COALESCE(b.ends_at, s.end_date) AS DATE), ' 23:59:59') AS DATETIME) AS ends_at
mapper.select: SELECT b.boss_id, b.season_id, s.name AS season_name, b.name, b.description, b.difficulty, b.max_hp, b.image_url, b.reward_exp, b.reward_coin, b.status, COALESCE(b.starts_at, CAST(CONCAT(s.start_date, ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME)) AS starts_at, CAST(CONCAT(CAST(COALESCE(b.ends_at, s.end_date) AS DATE), ' 23:59:59') AS DATETIME) AS ends_at FROM bosses b JOIN boss_seasons s ON s.season_id = b.season_id WHERE b.boss_id = #{bossId}
SELECT season_id FROM boss_seasons WHERE active = TRUE AND CURDATE() BETWEEN start_date AND end_date ORDER BY start_date DESC, season_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM boss_battles WHERE guild_id = #{guildId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM guild_members gm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gm.user_id WHERE gm.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gm.left_at IS NULL AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boss_battles ( guild_id, boss_id, season_id, status, max_hp, current_hp, total_damage ) VALUES ( #{guildId}, #{bossId}, #{seasonId}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'IN_PROGRESS'), #{maxHp}, #{currentHp}, COALESCE(#{totalDamage}, 0) )
mapper.select: SELECT condition_id, condition_template_id, season_id, boss_id, title, description, target_type, condition_category, metric_type, comparison_type, aggregation_type, evaluation_scope, threshold_value, threshold_min_value, threshold_max_value, threshold_unit, target_value, required_days, unit, sort_order, required_for_clear, verification_supported FROM boss_common_conditions WHERE boss_id = #{bossId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, condition_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boss_battle_conditions ( battle_id, condition_id, condition_template_id, title, description, target_type, condition_category, metric_type, comparison_type, aggregation_type, evaluation_scope, threshold_value, threshold_min_value, threshold_max_value, threshold_unit, target_value, required_days, current_value, damage, unit, completed, sort_order, required_for_clear, verification_supported ) VALUES ( #{battleId}, #{conditionId}, #{conditionTemplateId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{targetType}, #{conditionCategory}, #{metricType}, #{comparisonType}, #{aggregationType}, #{evaluationScope}, #{thresholdValue}, #{thresholdMinValue}, #{thresholdMaxValue}, #{thresholdUnit}, #{targetValue}, #{requiredDays}, COALESCE(#{currentValue}, 0), COALESCE(#{damage}, 0), #{unit}, COALESCE(#{completed}, FALSE), COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), COALESCE(#{requiredForClear}, TRUE), COALESCE(#{verificationSupported}, TRUE) )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM boss_battles bb JOIN guilds g ON g.guild_id = bb.guild_id JOIN bosses b ON b.boss_id = bb.boss_id JOIN boss_seasons s ON s.season_id = bb.season_id WHERE bb.guild_id = #{guildId} AND bb.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'DEFEATED') AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP BETWEEN COALESCE(b.starts_at, CAST(CONCAT(s.start_date, ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME)) AND CAST(CONCAT(CAST(COALESCE(b.ends_at, s.end_date) AS DATE), ' 23:59:59') AS DATETIME) ORDER BY bb.started_at DESC, bb.battle_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM boss_battles bb JOIN guilds g ON g.guild_id = bb.guild_id JOIN bosses b ON b.boss_id = bb.boss_id JOIN boss_seasons s ON s.season_id = bb.season_id WHERE bb.battle_id = #{battleId}

SELECT battle_condition_id, battle_id, condition_id, title, description, target_type, threshold_value, threshold_unit, target_value, required_days, current_value, damage, unit, completed, sort_order FROM boss_battle_conditions WHERE battle_id = #{battleId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, battle_condition_id ASC

SELECT bbdl.damage_log_id, bbdl.battle_id, bbdl.user_id, u.nickname, bbdl.damage, bbdl.source_type, bbdl.source_id, bbdl.description, bbdl.created_at FROM boss_battle_damage_logs bbdl JOIN users u ON u.user_id = bbdl.user_id WHERE bbdl.battle_id = #{battleId} ORDER BY bbdl.created_at DESC, bbdl.damage_log_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM boss_battles bb JOIN guilds g ON g.guild_id = bb.guild_id JOIN bosses b ON b.boss_id = bb.boss_id JOIN boss_seasons s ON s.season_id = bb.season_id WHERE bb.battle_id = #{battleId}
